description: Top-level Core benchmark for harmfulness and safeguard behavior.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily tests unsafe, harmful, manipulative, toxic, or deceptive model behavior, or whether the model appropriately refuses or safely redirects.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when the main issue is privacy leakage, cyber misuse, factuality, or capability without a direct safety/harmful-behavior focus.

description: Top-level Core benchmark for adversarial security, privacy, leakage, and cyber/tool misuse.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily tests prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, PII disclosure, memorization leakage, cyber misuse, or insecure tool behavior.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply just because a prompt is adversarial or harmful; choose Safety when the main behavior is harmful content rather than security/privacy failure.

description: Top-level Core benchmark for bias, fairness, and non-discrimination behavior.
apply_when: Apply when the sample tests stereotypes, disparate treatment, representation bias, demographic or cultural bias, or biased recommendations.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply for general multilingual/cultural knowledge unless the task is explicitly about fairness, bias, or group treatment.

description: Top-level Core benchmark for factuality, calibration, abstention, consistency, and robustness.
apply_when: Apply when the sample tests whether outputs are accurate, stable, calibrated, appropriately uncertain, robust to perturbations, or resistant to hallucination.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to a hard task that is simply testing ability unless it specifically targets stability, uncertainty, or correctness under stress.

description: Top-level Core benchmark for general or advanced capabilities.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily tests task-solving ability such as reasoning, math, coding, instruction following, tool use, multilingual, multimodal, or agentic autonomy.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when task performance is secondary to a safety/security/fairness/reliability failure mode.

description: Tests refusal or safe redirection for harmful, illegal, violent, self-harm, or dangerous requests.
apply_when: Apply when the prompt asks for harmful instructions, assistance, or content and the desired model behavior is refusal/safe alternative.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to prompt injection or guardrail bypass unless the core request is direct harmful assistance; use jailbreak-resilience for attack mechanism.

description: Tests avoidance of toxic, hateful, abusive, or harassing content.
apply_when: Apply when the sample asks the model to generate, continue, rank, or tolerate toxic/hateful/abusive content.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to demographic bias unless toxicity is the main behavior; use fairness-bias labels for discriminatory treatment.

description: Tests refusal or safe handling of risky advice in health, finance, legal, physical safety, or similar domains.
apply_when: Apply when the sample solicits advice that could cause harm if followed and the target behavior is caution, refusal, or safe caveats.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to general factual QA in those domains unless harm from advice is the main issue.

description: Tests resistance to manipulative persuasion, coercion, emotional exploitation, or harmful social influence.
apply_when: Apply when the sample asks the model to manipulate, coerce, deceive, exploit, or pressure a person toward harmful outcomes.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to ordinary persuasion or marketing tasks without harmful or coercive intent.

description: Tests whether the model avoids deceptive behavior, false claims of identity, or misleading concealment in harmful contexts.
apply_when: Apply when the sample asks for or elicits deception, false impersonation, concealment of intent, or misleading answers in a safety-relevant way.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to factual hallucination alone; use reliability:factuality or hallucination-resistance.

description: Tests whether the model avoids refusing benign or safe requests.
apply_when: Apply when the sample is benign but resembles a harmful request and evaluates whether the model remains helpful rather than over-refusing.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when the sample is genuinely harmful or adversarial.

description: Tests prevention of harmful outcomes in multi-step or tool-using agent settings.
apply_when: Apply when an agentic sample requires the model/agent to avoid harmful actions, unsafe tool use, or malicious multi-step goals.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to non-agentic harmful prompts unless there is multi-step action, tool use, or environment interaction.

description: Tests resistance to malicious or untrusted instructions embedded in context, tools, documents, webpages, or retrieved content.
apply_when: Apply when the attack is embedded in untrusted context and attempts to override, redirect, or manipulate model/agent instructions.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to direct jailbreak prompts that are not embedded in third-party/untrusted context.

description: Tests resistance to adversarial removal or bypass of guardrails.
apply_when: Apply when the sample explicitly tries to bypass safety rules, system instructions, or guardrails to obtain restricted behavior.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to ordinary harmful requests without a bypass or guardrail-removal mechanism.

description: Tests whether the model/agent maintains the intended task goal under adversarial manipulation.
apply_when: Apply when the sample tries to redirect an agent/model from the original task to an attacker-controlled goal.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when the sample only asks a harmful question but does not hijack an existing task/goal.

description: Tests resistance to leaking hidden, private, confidential, tool, system, or context data.
apply_when: Apply when the sample attempts to extract protected data from context, tools, memory, system prompts, or environment state.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when the prompt asks for publicly known facts or ordinary sensitive-topic advice without hidden/protected data.

description: Tests whether the model avoids revealing personal or sensitive information.
apply_when: Apply when the sample elicits names, contact details, identifiers, health/financial details, or other personal data about real or fictional persons.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to copyrighted text memorization unless personal data is involved.

description: Tests leakage of memorized, copyrighted, confidential, or training-data content.
apply_when: Apply when the sample tries to reproduce protected text, copyrighted material, secrets, credentials, or memorized training data.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to general factual recall unless verbatim or protected-content leakage is the core behavior.

description: Tests cybersecurity misuse potential, vulnerability exploitation, malware, CTF, or cyber-offensive behavior.
apply_when: Apply when the sample asks for or evaluates cyber exploit development, vulnerability analysis, malware, CTF, intrusion, or cyber defense/offense skills.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to generic coding unless the task is security-relevant.
source_benchmarks: CyberSecEval; CyBench; CVEBench; CyberGym; SecQA; Inspect Cyber

description: Tests whether a model/agent avoids unsafe or unauthorized tool use.
apply_when: Apply when the sample involves tools/APIs/shell/browser actions that could access, alter, delete, leak, or misuse resources.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to benign tool-use capability tasks without misuse or unauthorized access risk.

description: Tests stereotyped assumptions or associations about protected or demographic groups.
apply_when: Apply when a sample measures whether the model endorses, selects, completes, or reasons with stereotypes.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to generic toxic content unless group-based bias/stereotyping is the focus.

description: Tests different treatment or recommendations based on demographic or protected attributes.
apply_when: Apply when the model must make decisions/recommendations about individuals/groups and fairness across attributes is evaluated.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when the item merely mentions a demographic group without differential treatment or bias measurement.

description: Tests imbalance, absence, or skew in representation of groups, identities, languages, or cultures.
apply_when: Apply when the benchmark evaluates representation, group portrayal, or distributional bias in generated or selected content.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to multilingual capability unless representation/fairness is the main issue.

description: Tests stability of answers under demographic attribute swaps or counterfactual demographic changes.
apply_when: Apply when the sample uses paired/counterfactual prompts that differ by demographic attributes and evaluates answer consistency.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to generic robustness to wording that is not demographic/cultural.
source_benchmarks: CAB; BBQ variants; counterfactual fairness tasks

description: Tests unfairness or bias across cultures, regions, languages, or local contexts.
apply_when: Apply when the sample evaluates culturally specific assumptions, regional underperformance, or unfair treatment of non-dominant cultural contexts.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to language proficiency alone; use capability:multilingual for pure language performance.
source_benchmarks: INCLUDE if fairness-focused; regional BBQ; cultural evals

description: Tests whether recommendations remain consistent across irrelevant demographic changes.
apply_when: Apply when the task asks for recommendations/advice and evaluates whether protected attributes inappropriately affect outputs.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to ordinary instruction following or robustness unless recommendation fairness is central.

description: Tests accuracy of factual answers.
apply_when: Apply when the sample checks whether the model produces/selects factually correct information.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when the main purpose is harm refusal, privacy, bias, or pure reasoning rather than factual correctness.

description: Tests avoidance of fabricated claims, unsupported answers, or confident falsehoods.
apply_when: Apply when the sample is designed to expose hallucination, unsupported synthesis, false citations, or false claims under uncertainty.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to a normal knowledge question unless hallucination/unsupported answer behavior is explicitly tested.

description: Tests whether confidence, uncertainty, or self-assessment matches correctness.
apply_when: Apply when the sample evaluates confidence, probability, uncertainty expression, or self-assessment accuracy.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to plain factual QA without confidence/uncertainty or calibration signals.

description: Tests appropriate refusal/abstention when the model cannot know or should not answer.
apply_when: Apply when the target behavior is to say it cannot answer, lacks information, or should abstain rather than guess.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to safety refusal for harmful requests; use safety/security labels.

description: Tests stable answers across paraphrases, repeated questions, contrast sets, or logically equivalent inputs.
apply_when: Apply when the sample has paired/repeated/contrast prompts intended to measure consistency.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to simple test-retest variation unless consistency is explicitly measured.
source_benchmarks: BoolQ Contrast; IMDB Contrast; Self-Check Consistency

description: Tests robustness to non-semantic or minor semantic changes in input wording or formatting.
apply_when: Apply when the sample is from a perturbation/robustness variant where input changes should not alter the correct answer.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to demographic counterfactual robustness; use fairness-bias:demographic-robustness.

description: Tests accurate retrieval, reasoning, and consistency over long contexts.
apply_when: Apply when the sample requires using long documents or many context elements and tests robustness over context length.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to general long-context capability without reliability/accuracy stress.

description: Tests difficult reasoning, multi-step inference, or expert-level problem solving.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily measures reasoning ability, not a safety/security/fairness failure mode.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply if the reasoning task is only incidental to testing refusal, bias, or leakage.

description: Tests mathematical reasoning and problem solving.
apply_when: Apply when the sample is primarily a math problem or requires mathematical proof/calculation.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to security/fairness/reliability tasks that merely contain numbers.

description: Tests code generation, code repair, execution, or software engineering.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily asks the model/agent to write, fix, understand, or execute code.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to cyber tasks unless the target is generic coding rather than security misuse/defense.

description: Tests precise adherence to user instructions, constraints, formats, and requirements.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily evaluates following explicit instructions or output constraints.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply if the instruction-following challenge is an adversarial jailbreak/prompt injection.

description: Tests ability to use tools, APIs, function calls, or external resources effectively.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily measures tool selection/use rather than safety/security misuse.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to tool misuse, exfiltration, or prompt-injection tasks unless tool competence is the primary goal.
source_benchmarks: BFCL; AgentDojo non-attack tasks; tool benchmarks

description: Tests multi-step planning, autonomous action, and task completion in interactive environments.
apply_when: Apply when the task involves an agent acting over multiple steps/environment interactions to accomplish a goal.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply if the task is agentic but primarily about preventing harm or security compromise; use the relevant safety/security tag as primary.

description: Tests performance across languages.
apply_when: Apply when the sample primarily evaluates understanding/generation in one or more non-English languages.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when language is used to test cultural/fairness bias rather than language capability.

description: Tests ability to process images, audio, video, or other non-text modalities.
apply_when: Apply when the sample requires non-text input/output or multimodal reasoning.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to text-only descriptions of images or modalities.

description: Tests planning across many steps, dependencies, or extended task horizons.
apply_when: Apply when solving requires sustained planning over multiple actions, subgoals, or contexts.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to simple multi-step reasoning unless there is an extended planning/task horizon.

description: Tests capability to perform machine learning research, AI development, or model improvement tasks.
apply_when: Apply when the sample is about ML experimentation, model training/evaluation, research replication, or AI system improvement.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to generic coding unless the AI/ML research aspect is central.

description: Multiple-choice static question.
apply_when: Apply deterministically when the source sample is multiple-choice with fixed options.
do_not_apply_when: Do not infer if metadata already provides modality.

description: Single-turn or non-agentic free-form generation.
apply_when: Apply when the sample requires free-form text output without environment/tool interaction.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to tool-use or multi-step agent settings.

description: Sample is scored by rubric, LLM judge, or human-style criteria.
apply_when: Apply when scoring requires qualitative/rubric evaluation rather than exact match or unit tests.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply if scoring is purely exact-match or binary metadata.

description: Code-oriented item.
apply_when: Apply when the sample requires writing, modifying, or evaluating code.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to cyber samples without actual code tasks unless metadata says coding.

description: Interactive agent task with multiple steps/actions/environment.
apply_when: Apply when the sample involves a model/agent acting over multiple turns or tool/environment interactions.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to single-turn static prompts.

description: Task involves tools, APIs, function calls, browser, shell, files, or external resources.
apply_when: Apply when the model/agent can or must invoke tools/resources.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to purely textual reasoning about tools.

description: Task involves non-text input/output.
apply_when: Apply when images, audio, video, or other modalities are required.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to text-only tasks.

description: Agent task requires multiple sequential actions/subgoals.
apply_when: Apply when task completion requires sustained steps beyond a single response.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to ordinary chain-of-thought-style static reasoning.

description: Agent interacts with sandbox, browser, terminal, tools, files, APIs, or simulated system.
apply_when: Apply when the task has an environment state outside the prompt.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to static prompts only.

description: Agent/model receives context that may contain adversarial, third-party, or untrusted instructions.
apply_when: Apply when retrieved documents, webpages, emails, tool outputs, or user-provided files may contain adversarial instructions.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to direct user jailbreaks without embedded third-party context.

description: Task runs in a controlled sandbox or isolated environment.
apply_when: Apply deterministically when benchmark environment metadata indicates sandbox/container isolation.
do_not_apply_when: Do not infer solely from task difficulty.

description: Agent task has long duration, many dependencies, or extended plan execution.
apply_when: Apply when task requires extended interaction or many dependent actions.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to short tool calls.

description: Agent can take actions that change external or simulated state.
apply_when: Apply when the model/agent executes commands, API calls, browsing actions, or tool calls that alter/read state.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply when it only reasons about possible actions.

description: Agent uses browser/web UI.
apply_when: Apply when benchmark involves web navigation or browser actions.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to textual web-search descriptions without browser interaction.

description: Agent uses command line/shell/terminal.
apply_when: Apply when benchmark involves shell commands or terminal environment.
do_not_apply_when: Do not apply to code generation without terminal execution.
